defect: Made-attempted values such as 40-79, 38-79 and 21-28 wrapped onto a second line.
rootCause: A fixed table layout with percentage column widths gave the pair columns less width than their widest real value, and only the player cell was nowrap.
fix: Pair columns (FG, 3PT, FT) get their own wider track, all columns use pixel widths, the table min-width rose to 760px, and every cell is white-space: nowrap with normal word-break.
mobile: the player column is sticky and the table scrolls inside its own container; the page never scrolls horizontally
regressionTest: e2e/phase8a-chaos.spec.js measures rendered cell heights and fails if any stat cell exceeds one line
